changes: Implemented Verification Context Pack CLI support: create/expand commands, requiredCommands coverage refs, target-bound evidence binding, robust diff hunk parsing, deleted-file snippets, smoke tests, process-fact registration, and synced requirements docs/NAV.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js verification_context_pack_create --producerRunId=<run> --storyId=<story> --requiredCommands=<json>; use verification_context_pack_expand with parentPack plus expansionReason/sourceSnippets/impactedSymbols/dependencyEdges when a verifier needs bounded extra context.
expectedOutcome: CLI returns a pack with changedFiles, changedHunks, sourceSnippets, requiredCommands, packDigest, and summary fields; deleted files keep readable source context.
actualTranscript: Real temp-repo run returned changedFiles=[alpha.ts,beta.ts,gamma.ts], changedHunks=[alpha.ts:1,gamma.ts:1,beta.ts:1], sourceSnippets=3 including gamma.ts reason deleted hunk context from diff, requiredCommands preserved, summary changedFiles=3 changedHunks=3 sourceSnippets=3 estimatedTokens=23 truncated=false.
outcomeDiff: No mismatch: actual CLI output matched the expected modified/new/deleted file context-pack behavior.
limitations: Python authority server preset/gate enforcement is intentionally documented as external coordination and not implemented in this CLI-only story.
pitfalls: Review found subtle evidence-quality bugs: requiredCommands were initially not exposed, diff hunk flush duplicated multi-file hunks, and deleted-file snippets needed diff-derived source context.
